title: Battle Pass
needs_owner_check: Written for mc-server 63529705; prod deploy 20261123-014534 was still running (the merge changed one premium reward, Telepathy IV to Telepathy). Season dates are from settings.yml and the week files (Season 4 Heartwood, 05/11 to 09/12/2026); the page goes stale when Season 5 starts. The +25% progress booster in settings.yml is left out because who gets it was not confirmed.
summary: **Battle Pass** is the SMP's seasonal reward track. Daily and weekly quests earn points, points unlock tiers, and every tier you reach has a reward to claim. The current season is Season 4, Heartwood.

blocks.p: Everyone has the Free Pass. Open it with `/bp` (also `/battlepass` or `/pass`), and see your quests with `/quests`. The premium track, the **Chroma Pass**, is sold on [the store](/store/) and lasts for one season.

ul: Each tier takes 60 points, so all 50 tiers take 3,000.
Rewards are not given automatically. Click a reached tier in `/bp` to claim it.
**Daily quests**: 7 at a time (3 easy, 2 medium, 1 hard and 1 random), worth 8, 12 or 18 points. They reset every day at 12:00 (Oslo time).
**Weekly quests**: a new week opens every 7 days. Older weeks stay open, so you can catch up. Quests 9 and 10 of each week are for Chroma Pass holders only.
Points past tier 50 turn into money: $25 a point on the Free Pass, $75 on the Chroma Pass.

blocks.p: Season 4 runs from 5 November to 9 December 2026:

ul: Week 2, Root and Resin (12 to 18 November).
Week 3, Into the Heartwood (19 to 25 November): the Easy dungeon areas.
Week 4, The Deep Roots (26 November to 2 December): the Medium and Hard areas.
Week 5, Heart of the Tree (3 to 9 December): the boss at the core.

blocks.p: The free track has a reward on 35 of the 50 tiers, including Living Prism Keys, Living Prism, Prismatic Resin, Chroma Keys, Shard Keys and Prism Shards.
The Chroma Pass claims both tracks and adds a reward on every tier. Tier 50 is Heart of the Tree: 3 Living Prism Keys, 12 Living Prism, 40 Prismatic Resin and a StatTrak.

ul: Living Prism Keys open the [Living Prism Crate](/wiki/smp/crates/).
Weeks 3 to 5 send you into [Heartwood](/wiki/smp/dungeons/), so gear up before then.
A new season resets the pass, and a Chroma Pass does not carry over.
